blind.description: A low wooden tub reinforced with two riveted metal bands, packed with miscellaneous shop stock. Inside are three tied cloth sacks (one red, one yellow, and one red-and-cream striped), two wooden hand brooms or brushes, a small metal lantern, and a coil of rope resting over the rim. Surfaces are stylized, clean, solid, and continuous with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A circular wooden tub with a metallic rim, containing clustered items: a yellow tied pouch, two brush heads, a striped sack, an orange sack, a small hexagonal-topped lantern, and a coil of rope draped over the left rim edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the figure (around 1.8 to 2 feet high) and roughly 2 to 2.5 feet wide.
